Your NAD+ Declines 50% by Age 40

Research published in Nature Aging shows a clear link between NAD+ levels and healthy aging. NAD+ (nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide) is found in every cell in your body—it's essential to the chemistry that keeps you up and running.

But here's the problem: NAD+ levels decline universally as we age. By age 40, most people have lost half their NAD+. By 60, it's down to just 25% of youthful levels.

Your Cells Are Energy Factories

Mitochondria: The Cellular Power Plants

Every cell in your body contains mitochondria, tiny organelles that convert nutrients and oxygen into ATP, the energy currency your cells use to function. Think of them as power plants inside each cell.

The problem? As we age, mitochondria become less efficient and we produce fewer of them. The result: declining energy, slower recovery, and accelerated aging.

FAQs

  • What is the New Advanced Daily Ultimate Longevity?

    The New Advanced Daily Ultimate Longevity is our revolutionary powder supplement that represents the most comprehensive longevity formula ever created. It’s a scientifically designed 5-complex system featuring a 1,100% increase in active ingredient capacity compared to traditional capsule formats, allowing us to target all 12 hallmarks of aging with therapeutic doses of premium ingredients. This advanced powder comes in convenient individual sachets with a delicious açaí pomegranate flavor, making it the perfect complement to our Daily Ultimate Essentials for a complete longevity routine in one refreshing drink.

  • How do I take the new powder?

    Simply empty one sachet into 8-10 fl. oz. of cold water, juice, or your favorite beverage, preferably in the morning with a meal. The powder dissolves easily and has a pleasant açaí pomegranate flavor. You can adjust the amount of liquid to your taste preference - use less water for a more concentrated flavor or more for a lighter taste. For most optimal benefits, mix one sachet together with the Daily Ultimate Essentials in 8-12 fl. oz. of cold water.

  • What makes this the best longevity product on the market?

    New Advanced Daily Ultimate Longevity powder stands apart from all competitors in several key ways:

    • Unprecedented Ingredient Capacity: With a 1,100% increase in active ingredient capacity compared to traditional capsule formats, we can deliver therapeutic doses that competitors simply cannot match in their limited capsule forms.
    • Comprehensive Coverage: While other longevity supplements like Tru Niagen focus on just one pathway (NAD+ boosting), our formula addresses all 12 hallmarks of aging through multiple synergistic mechanisms.
    • Therapeutic Dosing: We provide clinically meaningful doses of each ingredient based on human research. For example, our 3-gram dose of L-Glycine and 2-gram dose of Taurine are based on breakthrough longevity research, while competitors often use “fairy dust” amounts.
    • Premium Ingredients: We use the highest quality forms of each ingredient, including dihydroberberine (5x more bioavailable than regular berberine), AstaPure® astaxanthin, and purest form of NMN.
    • Scientific Innovation: Our 5-complex system is the first to organize longevity ingredients by biological function rather than arbitrary groupings, ensuring optimal synergistic effects.
    • Enhanced Bioavailability: The powder format with individual sachets provides superior absorption compared to capsules while maintaining ingredient stability.

  • How long before I see results?

    While individual results vary, many customers report results within the first few weeks. The longevity benefits of targeting cellular aging processes develop over time with consistent use. For optimal results, we recommend taking Daily Ultimate Longevity powder consistently as part of your daily routine.

    • After 30 Days: Building Your Cellular Foundation Experience enhanced physical performance and better stamina as your cellular energy production gets optimized. You may notice more restful sleep and a sense of hormonal awakening as your body begins building its longevity foundation from within.
    • After 60 Days: Activating Cellular Protection Feel greater vitality and resilience as powerful antioxidants protect your cells while senolytic compounds help clear out old, dysfunctional cells. Sustained energy throughout the day and improved focus become your new normal.
    • After 90 Days: The Compounding Effects Begin This is where the real magic happens. Experience the powerful compounding effects of consistent longevity support as profound cellular renewal becomes evident in skin health, cognitive function, and overall well-being. Your body’s natural repair processes are now optimized - and the benefits only continue to build from here.
